tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum sa lugs kyi cho ga 'phags pa mnyes byed bzhugs so/ /na massad gu ru pā dā ya/ grangs med bskal par tshogs gnyis rab bsags shing / /dpag med yon tan ma lus mngon gyur nas/ /tshad med thugs rjes 'gro kun rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /lhag pa'i lha de tshul bzhin mnyes byed pa'i/ /sgrub thabs rim pa phyi rol tshogs gsog dang / /gzungs sgrub cho ga rjes gnang bya tshul rnams/ /legs par bshad kyi dad ldan spro bas nyon/ /'dir thugs rje chen po bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gnas dben par 'khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun par byas la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed nas/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hriḥyig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ arya a wa lo ki ti shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes mtshan sngags lan gcig sbyar ba'i arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā dyaṃ nas shapta pra titstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs brjod pas 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dkar po dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hriḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/

sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hriḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs khar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas rin po che'i phreng ba dang / g.yon 'og mas padma dkar po 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis gzigs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i g.yas su nor bu 'dzin pa dang / g.yon du yi ge drug ma gnyis sku mdog rab tu dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs khar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon gyi gnyis pas padma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i bstod du zla ba la hriḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbyer med du bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hriḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba rtsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas gsum ka la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam la/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad nas yun ring du bsgom pas skyo na rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hriḥyig dkar po dang de'i mdun nas/ g.yas bskor du yi ge drug pa mgo gyen bstan du gnas pa de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas/ rang la thim pas byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla bar bya'o/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag drug kha bskong dang bcas yin no/ /thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa rtsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i don zhus nas rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di'i sogs dang / byang chub sems mchog rin po che sogs/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing sogs dang / bsngo ba smon lam ci shes bya'o/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na dkar gtor gtsang ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags kyis spyan drangs te/

mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas te mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i/ ā kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul nas sngar bzhin mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ khyed kyis sems can don sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes pas gtor mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol nas/ spyod lam thams cad du thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi kun nas slangs te/ sems can gyi don la brtson par bya'o/ /mdun bskyed la brten nas tshogs gsog bya bar 'dod na/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du maṇḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa la 'bru gtsang ma'i tshom bu dbus su che ba dang / g.yas g.yon du cung zad chung ba re bkod/ de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas bskor dang / mdun du gtor ma gcig dang / gzhan yang spos mar me zhal zas la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams/ rang gi mdun du rol mo'i chas dang maṇḍal gyi yo byad rnams sta gon bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil sogs nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du pā dyaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i mthar dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo/ /de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gdan bsdu ba'i bar bdag bskyed gong bzhin byas la/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma zhes sogs nas/

gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar snga ma ltar bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ ma lus sems can sogs tshigs bcad gsum dang / mtshan sngags kyi mthar e hye hi zhes pas spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan phul/ sngar bzhin mchod nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ dbang lha spyan 'dren nas 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa'i bar bya/ slar yang mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis rlabs te/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad du mos nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang / /sogs nas/ bdag nyid chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang mchod/ /ces mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad dang sngags 'don pa bsgyur zhing dharma ra ṇi ta sogs kyis rol mo dbul/ gang yang bdag gi dus kun tu/ /zhes sogs sam/ mi shes na bzang spyod kyi dbu nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ sngar gyi bstod pa dang gtor ma sngon bzhin dbul lo/ /de nas maṇḍal dbul te/ oṃ badzra bhu mi sogs nas ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i yi dam thugs rje chen po la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don sogs spyi dang mthun par brjod/ de lta bu brgya phrag re'i mtshams su bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu lan mang du phul ba'i mthar/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par mthar pa las byang chub ba'i mchod sprin lta bu yid las byung ba'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul bar bsam la/

phal po che'i mdo'i don bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtsho zhes pa la sogs pa brjod/ de'i rjes su shes shing nus na zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i smre bsngags brjod pas gsol ba gdab/ de nas gtso ba'i thugs khar zla ba la hriḥdang sngags bkod nas/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs par bsam la/ yi ge drug pa stong phrag la sogs pa bzla'o/ /de nas slar yang mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis rlabs/ mtshan sngags re re mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa bsdus pa dang / 'dod don zhus la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs kyi rjes su oṃ badzra muḥ tshom bu'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes dang / rang gi dpral bar oṃ la sogs pas gnas gsum bsrung / ston mchog dam pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis bya'o/ /bum pa la brten nas gzungs sgrub bya bar 'dod na/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa nang rdzas rdor gzungs dang bcas pa spyi dang mthun pa'i mthar mchod gtor gong ltar bshams la byin gyis rlabs pa'i bar bdag bskyed bsgoms/ bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'chang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpags sam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su paṃ las padma dkar po dang / ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hriḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi lha gsum yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/

de la mchod pa nas gsol ba gdab pa'i bar tshogs gsog gi skabs bzhin rgyas par bya/ bzlas pa'i tshe rang gi snying ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzugs thag la bsten nas song bas lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul te/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing gzungs thag nas bzung la/ yi ge drug pa khri khrag la sogs pa bzla'o/ /'jug tu mchod bstod bsdus pa/ 'dod don zhu ba/ lhag chad kha bskangs ba/ bzod par gsol ba rnams gong bzhin byas pa'i mthar dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam mo/ /de lta bu thun du bcad pa'i sgo nas zhag mang du bya ba ni/ gzungs sgrub rgyas par bya ba'i tshul yin la/ gnas skabs gzhan du 'khrus chog tsam don du gnyer na/ gzhan rnams snga ma ltar las bum par lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa la mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas bzlas pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /gang ltar yang 'khrus bya tshul dngos ni/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel na de nyid dang / ma 'brel na thugs rje chen po'i sku gzugs gzhan me long gi nang du 'char bar byas pa'am/ de yang ma 'byor na yi dam gtso 'khor gsum spyan drangs nas de rnams la sku 'khrus gsol bar bsam la/ me long gi ngos la bum pa'i chu blug cing / 'gro ba'i sgron me spyan ras gzigs mgon la/ /dri zhim bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis 'khrus gsol bas/ /'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis dri ma rnams bsal nas/ /dri bral sku gsum mdzes pa'i bkra shis shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ 'di ni 'khrus mchog sogs dang / khyed ni rang bzhin yang dag sogs dang / rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la sogs dang / 'khrus kyi khang pa sogs tshigs bcad rnams kyi rjes su sngar gyi sngags brjod pas bkru'o/

/de nas gos gtsang mas sku phyi ba'i tshul byas la/ de dag sku la sogs dang / oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ hriḥ.āḥkā ya bi shwa dha ne swā hā/ zhes brjod/ chu de bum par blug nas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i yi ge drug ma'i phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa rang gi spyi bo nas thim par bsam zhing / yi ge drug pa brjod nas lan gsum 'thung zhing bkrus pas/ dang po nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / gnyis pas shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / gsum pas chos sku skye med chos sku thob par bsgoms la/ nam mkha'i gtso 'khor gsum rang la thim par bsam mo/ /spro na bkru byab bsrung gsum gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /rjes gnang byed na tshom bu dang mchod gtor sngar bzhin bshams la/ byin gyis rlabs/ bdag bskyed bsgom/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod gtor bsdus pa dang / thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bzlas pa bya/ de nas slob ma rnams 'khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang mthar pa'i phan yon rnams zhib tu bshad la/ phan yon can de thob pa'i thabs la bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa las 'dir gsang sngags yin/ de la rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi yod pa las/ rigs sngags 'chang ba'i sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang / so so'i rgyud gnyis las/ so so'i rgyud yin zhing / de la rnam pa drug yod pa las/ padma'i rigs yin/ de la yang rigs kyi gtso bo dang / bdag po dang / yum dang / khro bo khro mo dang / bka' gnyan pho mo'i rgyud rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud yin/ de la rnam grangs mang du yod pa las/ za ma tog bkod pa la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brang nas/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' zhig rgyud sde gong ma dang mthun par bkral ba/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa las rgyud de rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' bab pa'i thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa rnams legs par grub nas/

khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum yod pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la 'jig rten dbang phyug dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thib pa ltar byas pa'i mos pa byas te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi'o/ /snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog /ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mongs ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes bzlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa brtsal du gsol/ de rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis swa bha wa sogs nas ham̐ zhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi phung po khams skye mched gzung 'dzin tha mal du snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs par mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dkar po sogs nas/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar gyis slob ma gtso 'khor gsum du bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs kar phog pas/

de thams cad kyi thugs brgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang gis lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang rol mo bya zhing / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra a be sha ya a āḥ.āḥzhes yang yang brjod/ de ltar byas pas thugs rje chen po'i sku'i byin rlabs bzhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus thugs rje chen po'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis rlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum gyis bsdus pa las/ thog mar rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs kar hriḥyig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags 'phreng gnyis pa byung / zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hriḥyig gi mthar 'khod par mos nas/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ ces dang / yig ge drug pa gsum mam brgya la sogs pa rjes bzlos byar bzhug de ltar bzlas pa dang pos rgyud byin gyis rlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos nas slob dpon la me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gi sogs lan gsum dang / slob dpon gyis me tog gi 'phreng ba sngags su byas nas khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis rlabs pa mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs rkang pa gnyis dang / sngags kyi dngos grub rtsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma rnams kyis rgyud la thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus par 'jug par gyur cig

ces brjod de me tog gtor ro/ /dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gsang sngags ci nus su bzla bar bgyi'o/ /snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar 'dzin cing / de'i gsang sngags ci nus su bzla bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar byas pas thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ ngag thugs rje chen po'i gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis rlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs brgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gyi sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re thugs ka nas rgyangs kyis byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim te/ thugs ka'i hriḥyig dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa byas/ de'i ngang las khyed rang lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher btad pas 'khor rnams 'od du zhu nas khyed rang la thim zhing / rang nyid kyang lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te thugs ka'i hriḥyig la thim/ de yang je chung je phrar gyur te/ nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas te cung zad gcig mnyam par zhog mdzod/

de ltar byas pas thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po'i thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis rlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces dang / gtso bos sogs brjod/ de ltar dam tshig 'dzin par khas blangs nas rjes gnang zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas lus longs spyod rnams kyang slob dpon la 'bul cha shas nas bzhes su gsol/ snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ ces dang / deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod do/ /rjes mchod bstod nas bkra shis kyi bar sngar bzhin bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni chos tshul 'di la brten nas byang chub thob 'dod pa'i blo gros can bsgom sde kun dga' rdo rjes rgyang ring mo nas bskul ba'i ngor/ bya bral dpal ldan don grub kyis slob dpon lhan skyes rol pa'i gzhung / bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab la gzhi byas/ cho ga'i yan lag thun mong ba sbyar du rung ba rnams skabs su babs par sbyar nas/ e waṃ chos 'khor rtser bris pa 'dis kyang 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho myur du skem par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ thams cad dge legs su gyur cig /dza yantu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 ngor mkhan po dpal ldan don grub/ thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum sa lugs kyi cho ga PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
